item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Fighting has resumed in the Kherson region after the longest ceasefire ended, with Russian strikes killing at least 26 people. Russian drones hit a Ukrainian railway station, killing 13, and Russia is fitting makeshift armor of nets and rubber tires to its shadow-fleet drones while deploying decoy drones for one-way attacks up to 1,200 km. Both Ukrainian hackers and Russian actors have compromised emergency alert apps to issue fake nuclear warnings. A Russian Su‑57 fighter was destroyed by an engine fire at Akhtubinsk airfield, and Russian troops have used the Oleshky ceasefire to mask movements. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Opposition leaders backed Defense Minister Eisenkot in an effort to remove Netanyahu, and peace envoys Mladenov and Blair arrived in Israel for Gaza talks following the Knesset election. The UN recorded 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Iran warned of a new battlefield after the reported U.S. strike, while Israeli officials called for new strikes on Iran and a missile hit a building in Tel Aviv. Gulf Arab states expressed concern over the war cloud as negotiations continue with Qatari mediators and U.S. officials. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Iran and the United States remain far apart on a deal to end the war while Qatar pushes mediation, and Iran negotiators left Qatar as a draft proposal circulated. item.title: Iraq: the situation
item.description:
Iraqi authorities have arrested several suspected smugglers linked to a boat sinking that killed three children in Erbil and to a child death case in Erbil, while Kurdish security forces also detained a smuggling suspect in a separate incident. Turkish troops have partially withdrawn from the Zilkan camp in Nineveh, and a drug squad in Kirkuk dismantled a trafficking ring operating across the border. A Jewish museum opened in Baghdad and Uzbekistan announced a trade centre in Erbil, reflecting efforts to attract foreign investment. Iran's parliament speaker reportedly met Iraqi militia leaders, and US officials signaled readiness to assist Erbil after a recent missile strike. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Somalia: the situation
item.description:

The United States and an East African nation have begun joint airstrikes against an al-Qaeda-linked group that earns $100 million, and the UAE carried out its first drone strike against al-Shabaab in nearly a year. Puntland mercenaries are fighting alongside Sudanese RSF forces, and the Sudanese army reports northern Somali fighters supporting the RSF. Somali pirates seized an Iranian fishing vessel and rescued seven Pakistani crew members, and there were 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
